question: payment

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/call request (jsonrpc 2.0, id 3) naming get_cross_chain_report_quote with empty arguments, the tool whose own description says it never initiates a payment; no payment header, no wallet, no signature

decoded.shape: a JSON-RPC result whose single text content is itself a JSON document of ten keys: service, access, amount, paymentRails, batch, request, response, authorization, privacy, docs
decoded.access: the document's access field reads paid and its amount field reads 0.02 USDC, USDT, or Binance-Peg BSC-USD
decoded.paymentRails: six rails, ethereum-usdc, base-usdc, arbitrum-usdc, polygon-usdc, ethereum-usdt and bsc-bsc-usd, each with a chainId, asset, decimals, token contract, explorer prefix, amount 0.02 and confirmationsRequired 12; all six name the SAME recipient address, and every address in the artifact is shortened to its first and last four hex digits because the publisher's secret filter reads a 40-hex string as a credential
decoded.no-402: no HTTP 402 and no payment challenge of any kind: no x402 envelope, no PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, no accepts array, no MPP or Tempo challenge, and the strings x402, mpp and 402 appear zero times, case-insensitively, in BOTH the vendor's llms.txt (7,673 bytes) and its openapi.json (9,833 bytes), re-counted 2026-10-21 at 06:06Z at the same byte sizes; the one temporar match in the openapi document is a 503 description, "Public RPC or report storage temporarily unavailable; retry with the same payment", and carries none of the three strings
decoded.authorization: the document says the payer signs a message binding the address batch, the payment rail, the network and the transaction hash, and that the signature sends no funds
decoded.privacy: the document says raw address batches and reports are not stored and that a keyed HMAC fingerprint and a network-scoped transaction key prevent payment replay

finding: The quote door answers a stranger with no credential and no payment: 200, and a price document naming six rails at 0.02 of a listed stablecoin, 12 confirmations each and one recipient address. It corroborates the entry's payments cells rather than correcting them: machinePayable false with an empty protocols array is what this surface measures, because the price is published and the rails are named but no machine-payment protocol is offered anywhere in the exchange, and the vendor's own machine-readable surfaces carry no x402, MPP or 402 string. Payment here is a direct transfer the payer makes elsewhere and then proves. Measured 2026-10-20 at 18:08:03Z, one IP, nothing paid.
